author: Gmelin, 1789
habitat: 호소, 소택지, 간척지, 하천, 하구, 해안, 연못, 물가 풀밭
summary: 우리나라에서는 미조로 기록되는 작은 오리이다. 호수와 늪, 소택지, 간척지, 하천, 하구, 해안, 연못, 물가 풀밭 등에서 지낸다. 번식기에는 물가에 풀을 엮어 둥지를 짓고 알을 10개쯤 낳는데, 알 색은 흰색부터 올리브색까지 여러 가지이다. 미국과 캐나다에 분포한다.

points.en: white stripe at the border between breast and flanks

similar.how: 생김새와 색이 비슷하지만, 가슴과 옆구리 경계에 흰 줄이 있는 점이 가장 큰 차이다.

art.subject: Green-winged Teal (Anas carolinensis), adult male in breeding plumage, as seen in Korea from November to March: head chestnut with a broad, glossy green band from the eye to the nape, edged only faintly with thin buff lines; breast pinkish-buff with small dark spots; a bold vertical white bar on the side of the breast in front of the wing; flanks and back finely vermiculated grey, with no horizontal white stripe along the scapulars; a creamy-yellow triangle edged black on the side of the undertail; green speculum. Bill black; dark eye; legs grey.
art.pose: swimming on calm water, side view
art.scene: Korean wetland in winter: shallow pond with grassy margins and dry reeds; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view swimming: chestnut head with a glossy green eye-to-nape band, vertical white bar on the breast side, grey flanks without a horizontal white scapular stripe, creamy-yellow undertail triangle edged black
art.build: Very small dabbling duck, 32–39 cm, much smaller than a Mallard, compact with a short neck and a rather large rounded head. Bill black, short and narrow, shorter than the head. Legs short, grey. At rest the wingtips reach close to the tail tip. Tail short and pointed. Swims buoyantly in shallow water and dabbles at the edges; flies fast in tight flocks.
avoid: Do not paint a horizontal white stripe along the scapulars; that is the male Eurasian Teal (Anas crecca).
Do not give the green head band bold creamy-white borders; on this species they are faint.
Do not paint the male in brown eclipse plumage in a winter scene.
Do not make it as large as a Mallard.
